name: artist
label: One artist (from a photo)
about: The same person sings every line: each shot puts the artist from one reference photo in a new outfit, setting and light (Qwen-Image identity edit); the flash twins are the same artist in a different look, like quick costume changes.

close.lens: on a wide-angle lens very close to the face
close.sing: Handheld close-up of {who} singing straight into the camera. The lips form each word clearly with wide open mouth movements, expressive lips and jaw moving with the lyrics, natural breathing, small head bobs and eyebrow raises on the beat. The handheld camera stays very close and sways gently. No microphone. No one else in frame.

medium.lens: on a 35mm lens at chest height with the arms and hands visible
medium.sing: Handheld medium shot of {who} singing toward the camera. The lips form each word clearly with open mouth movements, shoulders, arms and hands move with the rhythm, natural breathing. The camera sways gently. No microphone.

wide.lens: on a 24mm lens a few meters away
wide.sing: Wide handheld shot of {who} singing and moving to the beat, the lips forming the words, body swaying and arms moving with the rhythm. The camera drifts slowly. No microphone.

casting.edit: Photo of the same person as in image 1. {shot}, singing straight into the lens with the mouth open mid-word, shot from {angle} {lens}. Wearing {wear}. {light}, {background}. Keep their exact face, identity, skin tone and hair. Candid photograph, natural colour, subtle film grain.
casting.twin: Change the outfit to {wear}, the lighting to {light} and the background to {background}. Keep the exact same person with the same face, identity and hair, and the same camera angle, framing, head position, mouth shape and expression. Photorealistic photo.
light: direct on-camera flash with hard shadows
warm red practical light from one side
flash mixed with warm ambient light
background: a bathroom with glossy tiles behind
a night street with bokeh behind
a deep blue painted wall behind
wear: a black tank top and thin chain necklace
a mesh top and layered chains
a satin slip top and gold hoops
casting.negative: fog, haze, smoke, static, bad teeth, deformed teeth, blurry, overexposed, underexposed, low contrast, washed out colors, excessive noise, poor lighting, flickering, distorted proportions, unnatural skin tones, deformed facial features, asymmetrical face, missing facial features, extra limbs, disfigured hands, low quality, still frame, closed mouth, microphone, watermark, overlay, titles, subtitles
